name: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
notable_fact: First President of India and the only one to serve two full terms.

name: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
notable_fact: First Vice President to become President. His birthday is celebrated as Teacher's Day.

name: Dr. Zakir Husain
notable_fact: First President to die in office.

name: Varahagiri Venkata Giri (V.V. Giri)
notable_fact: Only person to have held office as both acting President and elected President.

name: Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed
notable_fact: Second President to die in office. Signed the proclamation of Emergency in 1975.

name: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy
notable_fact: Youngest President (until Droupadi Murmu) and the only one elected unopposed.

name: Giani Zail Singh
notable_fact: First Sikh President. Presidency marked by Operation Blue Star and the 1984 riots.

name: Ramaswamy Venkataraman
notable_fact: Served as Vice President before becoming President.

name: Dr. Shankar Dayal Sharma
notable_fact: Served as Chief Minister of Bhopal and held several cabinet portfolios before his presidency.

name: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
notable_fact: Known as the 'Missile Man of India' and the first scientist to become President.

name: Pranab Mukherjee
notable_fact: Long-serving politician and former Finance Minister. Awarded the Bharat Ratna.

name: Ram Nath Kovind
notable_fact: Former Governor of Bihar and the second Dalit President.

name: Droupadi Murmu
notable_fact: First tribal woman to hold the highest constitutional office, and the youngest President upon taking office.
